caption: The drawing depicts a single, large, rounded ceramic jar or vessel placed centrally against a plain, light beige background. The jar is rendered in various shades of brown, with darker areas suggesting shadows and glaze variations, and the light reflecting on the curved surface is highlighted with lighter brown and off-white tones. The vessel has a wide mouth with a slightly flared rim, a gradually tapering body, and a narrower, rounded base. Near the upper part of the jar, there is an inscription in uppercase letters that reads “PAIL. CUSHMAN’S-STONEWARE.” The jar is positioned so that the interior rim is partially visible, showing thickness and the curvature of the lip. There are a few small black and brown speckles on the jar’s surface, indicating texture or imperfections typical of glazed ceramics. The overall composition is focused solely on the jar, with no additional objects or background elements present.
title: Jar
